title: 3737. Count Subarrays With Majority Element I

examples.explanation: Valid subarrays with target = 2 as the majority element: nums[1..1] = [2] nums[2..2] = [2] nums[1..2] = [2,2] nums[0..2] = [1,2,2] nums[1..3] = [2,2,3] So there are 5 such subarrays.
All 10 subarrays have 1 as the majority element.
target = 4 does not appear in nums at all. Therefore, there cannot be any subarray where 4 is the majority element. Hence the answer is 0.
